prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve the two-watch arrangement, white spacing, and precise finance-panel styling.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown.
Maintain the premium Apple-style minimal presentation with soft icy-white texture.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square premium wearable poster on a clean white background with subtle icy-blue texture. Place the cellphoneS logo and Apple Authorised Reseller mark at the top right. Add the gradient headline '#ĐEO MÊ Nhẹ Tay Tiện Cả Ngày', then the Apple logo and 'WATCH ULTRA 2'. Show two Apple Watch Ultra 2 renders: one front-facing with a dark watch face and one side profile with a circular perforated band loop. At the bottom, add blue price panels 'Lên đời chỉ từ 15.81 Triệu' and 'Hoặc Góp từ 55K / Ngày', plus orange finance icons with 'Lãi suất 0%', 'Trả trước 0đ | Phụ phí 0đ', and 'Thời hạn 12 Tháng'. Technical style: premium minimal wearable-product campaign poster, soft premium studio lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark background, incorrect Apple text, wrong watch shape, low resolution, cluttered composition, warped strap, watermark, signature
